short: Text, voice and avatar from ECoG in one participant hold as a demonstration; sensor and decoder are standard, and an LM trained on the test pool inflates the text result.
position: The paper changed the sensor (M05, 253-electrode high-density ECoG), the decoders (M06, CTC recurrent networks for phones, HuBERT units and gestures) and the output (M08, text, synthesized voice and avatar). M05 and M06 are standard, and the text result trails the [concurrent] intracortical system, which reached a similar error on a vocabulary about 120 times larger [@willett2023] (inference). M08 is the real departure but the weakest evidence: listeners got 54.4% of words wrong on the 1,024-word set, and the real-time avatar is animated from decoded audio. The strongest confound is the language model (M07), trained on the sentence pool that contains the test sentences. Speed, synthesis and personalised-voice claims rest on one participant, one model and comparisons across vocabularies and reference voices.
